System: ** Task **

You are a business process modelling expert, tasked with identifying which mentions of certain process relevant elements in textual descriptions of business processes belong to the same entity. These mentions are spans of text, that are of a certain type, and are marked in the text with xml-style tags, containing their type and an id.
We are only interested in mentions of type "activity_data" (data, objects, etc.) and "actor" (persons, departments, process participants). A mention refers to the same real world entity, e.g. via anaphoric (e.g. pronouns) or co-referent mentions (abbreviations, same text, etc.), or if it simply has very similar surface-form (similar text).

** Format **

List all mention ids belonging to one entity, separated by spaces, one entity per line.

** Format Example **

Given the following input:

This <activity_data id=2> text </activity_data> <activity id=3> contains </activity> multiple <activity_data id=0> mentions </activity_data> in <activity_data id=1> it </activity_data> . You <activity id=4> extract </activity> <activity_data id=5> them </activity_data> .

You will extract these entities:

2 1
0 5

** Notes **

Only list entities that have at least two mentions!

Entities are always made up of mentions of the same type, don't mix them.

Only extract entities of mentions of the types "activity_data" and "actor"!
Human: Please retrieve all entities from the following text.

# Text

When stock levels reach a predefined threshold , <activity_data id=13> a purchase order </activity_data> is automatically generated and sent to the supplier . Meanwhile , <actor id=9> the procurement team </actor> reviews the purchase order for accuracy and ensures that it aligns with budgetary constraints and supplier agreements . At the same time , <actor id=10> the warehouse team </actor> prepares for the incoming shipment by organizing storage space and updating the inventory system to reflect the expected delivery . Upon receipt of the goods , <actor id=11> the warehouse team </actor> conducts a quality check to ensure that the items meet the required standards and specifications . If the goods pass the quality check , they are added to the inventory , and the system is updated to reflect the new stock levels . In the event of any discrepancies or quality issues , <actor id=12> the procurement team </actor> is notified to resolve <activity_data id=14> the matter </activity_data> with the supplier . This process ensures that inventory levels are maintained efficiently , minimizing stockouts and overstock situations while optimizing storage space and resources .
